description: Fix the confusing comparison-image naming and make pixel-to-pixel comparison run for EVERY report, not just one. Today output/compare/ mixes three collision-prone name patterns in one flat folder: '<name> - page N.jpg' (conversion side-by-side from tools/compare.py), 'TEMPLATE <name> - page N.jpg' (template side-by-side from tools/compare.py --template), and 'PIXEL DIFF/PIXEL OVERLAY TEMPLATE <name> - page N.png' (from tools/pixel_diff.py, which only exists for the single fixed report). The user cannot tell which image is which and is frustrated that pixel diagnostics are generated for only one report. Introduce ONE clear, consistent, self-explanatory scheme and generate the SAME set of artefacts for every report. This is a tooling/output change; it must not alter the renderers. Independent of the renderer features, but the honest per-report pixel numbers it produces are most meaningful after FEAT-002..006 land, so run it last.
steps: Design decision (implement this concrete scheme): put each artefact class in its OWN subfolder under output/compare/ so names never collide and every report has a predictable set: output/compare/conversion/<name> - page N.jpg (side-by-side reference vs conversion output), output/compare/template/<name> - page N.jpg (side-by-side reference vs template output), output/compare/pixel/<name> - page N - diff.png and output/compare/pixel/<name> - page N - overlay.png (pixel diagnostics). Keep the human-readable '<name> - page N' stem consistent across all three; the folder disambiguates the kind. Remove the old inline 'TEMPLATE ' / 'PIXEL DIFF TEMPLATE ' / 'PIXEL OVERLAY TEMPLATE ' prefixes.

Update tools/compare.py: write conversion side-by-sides to output/compare/conversion/ and template side-by-sides (--template) to output/compare/template/, using the stem '<name> - page N.jpg' in both (no 'TEMPLATE ' prefix). Keep the SUBSTRING-match behaviour documented but ensure a bare `python tools/compare.py` and `python tools/compare.py --template` regenerate the whole set.

Update tools/pixel_diff.py: write diagnostics to output/compare/pixel/ as '<name> - page N - diff.png' and '<name> - page N - overlay.png' (drop the 'PIXEL DIFF TEMPLATE '/'PIXEL OVERLAY TEMPLATE ' prefixes). Preserve the lossless dimension-locked metrics and the DIMENSION MISMATCH guard and exit codes.

Add a batch mode so pixel-to-pixel runs for EVERY report (the user's 'why skipping others?'): allow `python tools/pixel_diff.py --all --template` to iterate sources.discover(), run page 1 (and optionally each page) for every report, print a per-report summary line (exact% / visible% or 'DIMENSION MISMATCH: ...'), and write the diff+overlay PNGs for every report that has matching dimensions. Reports that still DIMENSION MISMATCH must be listed explicitly rather than silently skipped.

Wire regeneration into the CLI/docs so the whole comparison set is reproducible: ensure `python tools/compare.py` + `python tools/compare.py --template` + `python tools/pixel_diff.py --all --template` regenerate the full, consistently-named set. Consider migrating existing files by regenerating rather than renaming.
Delete or regenerate the stale flat-named files in output/compare/ so only the new consistent scheme remains (do not leave the old ambiguous names behind).

Update README.md output/compare/ description and the tools' module docstrings to document the new scheme (conversion/, template/, pixel/ subfolders; '<name> - page N[- diff|- overlay]' stems; --all batch mode).

Regenerate the full comparison set and confirm every report now has conversion/ and template/ side-by-sides, and a pixel/ diff+overlay for every report whose dimensions match (with any residual mismatches listed).
acceptance_criteria: output/compare/ contains exactly three subfolders: conversion/, template/, pixel/, with no ambiguous flat 'TEMPLATE ...'/'PIXEL DIFF TEMPLATE ...' files remaining.
Every one of the 19 reports has output/compare/conversion/<name> - page 1.jpg and output/compare/template/<name> - page 1.jpg.

`python tools/pixel_diff.py --all --template` runs pixel comparison for ALL 19 reports, printing a per-report result line and writing diff+overlay PNGs under output/compare/pixel/ for every report whose dimensions match; any report still DIMENSION MISMATCH is listed, not silently skipped.
tools/compare.py and tools/pixel_diff.py single-report modes still work and write into the new subfolders with the consistent stem.
README.md and the tool docstrings document the new naming scheme and the --all batch mode.
verification: uv run python tools/pixel_diff.py "MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK" --template
